subject: error occurs after I use gl.filter.rdepth()

messages.author: b40d9a0724dacefc
messages.subject: error occurs after I use gl.filter.rdepth()
parts:
Hello,
I am working on a mac using Rstudio Version 2023.12.1+402 (2023.12.1+402).

First, I did start by using gl.compliance.check().  My genlight object is fine when I begin filtering and I am able to filter on maf and every other type of filter - just not if I run gl.filter.rdepth at any stage of the filtering process.  Second, I already solved my own problems by just not running this command anymore since it turned out no reads are removed at this step b/c our provider already screened on read depths.

Finally, I'm just reporting this in case anyone else has a problem. When I run gl.filter.rdepth() something happens to the genlight produced so that no additional commands can be used without failure and the same error message occuring ->

Error in array(NA, nLoc(x)) : negative length vectors are not allowed

When I first thought I had a problem I looked this up and it's supposedly often connected to Rstudio running out of memory.  I made sure that wasn't the problem.  Now I know that as long as I don't run this filter I have ZERO other issues using dartR or any other software on my genlight object.  

(By the way, thank you for this amazing software that is actually easy to use even when you aren't a programmer)!

Best.
